entries.en: Just checking for C-Sec records. I can only sell goods to authorized personnel.
I'll open the rare stocks for you, Commander. Enjoy.
Sounds good. Let me just set you up... whoa. This must be a mistake.
System's telling me to offer you our select stock... Spectre?
Well... I'd heard about that, but I didn't realize it was you. Sorry, Commander.
Excellent. I hope you find what you're looking for.
Sure thing, Commander. You have a good day, now.
How do you know who I am?
How did you know all that?
Just show me what you've got.
You know me?
Sure is.
I need supplies.
I'm done.
So, will you be purchasing anything today, Commander Shepard?
No offense, Commander, but what the hell were you thinking?
You could've blown Jenna's cover.
We were there to help her get out.
I gathered that. It might seem cold letting her take all the risk. But we're keeping a close eye on her.
This job isn't easy and it's usually unpleasant. I'll take help anywhere I can find it.
But since you're so concerned with her safety, maybe there's a way we can help each other.
You C-Sec grunts are always trying to play the angles.
It's part of the job. Now are you going to help me or not?
I do have several contingencies; she's just my option "A".
Okay, maybe you're right. She's not really cut out for this, anyway.
I'll cut her loose, even get her out of Chora's Den, no strings attached. But....
That still leaves my case unsolved. I could still use your help.
I'm trying to track down an illegal arms producer. I just need some of their product.
Thanks to Jenna's intel, I've learned there's a seller here on the Citadel.
Meet our man, named Jax, pick up the mods and bring them back here. That'll give me everything I need.
Come on, Commander, we're on the same side here.
Fine. But Jenna stays right where she is until this case is solved.
All right. I think we're done here, then. I'll have Jenna removed from Chora's Den, just like I said.
I don't follow you.
It's too dangerous. You need to find another way.
Do you really need to risk her life to get the information you want?
But you're still using her.
You're a smart guy, Chellick. Figure out another way.
Come on, Chellick. Do you really need a little human girl to help you solve your case?
I'll help you, but I need some details.
I'll persuade Jax to tell me where these mods are coming from.
Where can I find this Jax?
Why are you so concerned about these mods?
This is just too much work.
Sorry, Chellick, it's not going to happen.
What makes them illegal?
Sorry?
Get her out.
Is it worth it?
I saw that.
You don't need her.
Pathetic.
All right. What do you need?
I could just ask him.
What do you suppose happens when we lose that edge?
These give criminals an advantage we can't afford to let them keep.
No. You tip Jax off and all my leads will disappear faster than you can say "bad bust".
Jax is down in the lower level of the markets. I'll send word through our channels that you're the buyer.
That's it? Just buy the weapons?
That's it. Now, Jax will have his boys with him, but I don't want this turning into a firefight.
We have access to some of the most sophisticated weaponry there is. It's what gives us our edge.
This'll be over quickly.
I'll make sure that things don't get out of hand.
I'll get going.
I can talk to this Jax.
What the hell happened down there, Commander?
Commander. I hear you have something for me.
Excellent. This is everything I need. Hmm... maybe more than I need.
As for Jenna, I'll make sure we get her out of Chora's Den immediately.
I appreciate your help. It shows a lot of integrity. You didn't need to do anything after I let Jenna go.
Commander. Been to see Jax yet?
Good. Don't keep Jax waiting too long.
Jax needed killing. Here's your shipment.
Here's your shipment, Chellick.
I'll get to it soon.
Tell me again where I can find him.
I didn't like him.
Where's Jax?
Damn it. I've got to get on this right away, before Jax's superiors get wind of his death.
Jenna will be removed from harm's way.
You've put me in a bit of bind here, Commander.
Now, I need to the get these mods into evidence. Thanks again, Shepard.
See yourself out when you're ready.
Quit your whining. Here's your shipment.
What about our deal?
Commander. I'm a little busy right now.
Good to see you, Commander.
I'm busy, Commander.
Here, Commander, take this. I won't need it and you've earned some payment for your work.
We were there to help her.
Always thinking ahead, Detective?
Always playing the angles, Detective?
Shrewd, Detective.
Nice to see you're still working all the angles, Chellick.
Just buy the weapons? That's it?
You just want us to buy the weapons? That's it?
So we just purchase these weapons?
We were trying to help her.
We were just getting information, Chellick.
It's not that simple, Shepard.
Excuse me?
Watch your tone, Chellick.
Jenna first.
Don't cross me.
Keeping tabs on me?
Careful.
So long, Chellick.
Long shifts, short nights?
Work keeping you up at nights, Chellick?
Bye.
Alright.
Hey there-- oh. You're not C-Sec, are you? Did you want something?
What were you trying to explain to the officer before?
I overheard you.
Oh. All right then.
I am Jahleed. I came here to seek aid from the authorities, but they won't listen to me.
My colleague is trying to kill me. And I thought we were friends.
He's changed. He won't talk to me at work any more, and... he started following me.
Yesterday, he followed me all the way home. Just waiting for a chance.
I don't care what anyone thinks; he wants me gone. I know it.
Would you? That's all I want: someone to talk to him. Tell him to leave me alone.
He thinks he can just push me around, but you'll show him, won't you?
Oh, right. Well, he wanted to meet with me down in the wards, near the markets. He said he just wanted to talk, but I know better.
His name's Chorban. He's a salarian. You shouldn't have any trouble. He's just a scientist.
I've met some dangerous scientists in my time.
Um, I suppose you're right. Well, good luck. Let me know what he says.
All right. You're not the first one to say so. Goodbye, then.
Oh, there you are. Have you spoken with Chorban yet?
Oh, I think you'll find him down in the wards, near the markets. Good luck.
How do you know he wants you dead?
Is there something I can do? Talk to your friend, maybe?
Just tell me where he is and I'll go find him.
I don't have time for this right now.
I haven't gone there yet.
I'll get to it when I get to it.
Where is Chorban again?
Kill you?
Can't help you.
Directions.
Of course, I'm sure you will deal with it appropriately. Good luck.
Oh, it's you again. They still won't believe me, you know. Nobody believes me.
What won't anybody believe?
I'll just be on my way.
What do you want us to believe?
But I can't. What will happen to the data when I'm gone? Who will carry on our research?
You should've thought of that before you stole the data.
But this data could be used to unravel all the secrets of the keepers! Think what we could learn about the Citadel!
Well, it's still very preliminary. But our initial scans suggest the keepers are as old as the Citadel itself.
We might learn how the Citadel was built. Or why the keepers always rearrange things. The possibilities are limitless!
I suppose I should. All right, I'll take it back and continue work on it there.
